decisions.body: Identify the visible concern and verified work performed in each example. Distinguish cleaning, repair and added lettering through accurate captions rather than letting a photograph imply all three.

decisions.label: Explain the outcome honestly
decisions.body: Use the actual after image and any relevant limitations. A successful result on one stone should not diagnose another or guarantee removal of its marks. Keep that boundary beside the comparison, where the family is forming expectations.

decisions.label: Invite an assessment request
decisions.body: Ask for the memorial’s identity, cemetery context and observed concern. Let the customer raise additional work, such as wording, separately from appearance. Explain current site coordination and review without asking the family to select a cleaning method.
